To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the open learner model MyExperiences is a visualization of the evidence that a user has acquired knowledge, and of the evidence that the user has not acquired knowledge.

(i) users are more satisfied with an open learner model that provides a visualization of the data than with one that only displays a summary, (ii) users prefer a visualization that is based on a tree map, rather than a bar graph, (iii) users are more likely to use an open learner model when it provides a visualization of data, and (iv) users are more confident when they can inspect the data used to make the inferences.
the visualization of evidence in open learner models can help learners to understand the system’s inferences about them.

the design and evaluation of MyExperiences as a tool that can help the users to understand the inferences made by an adaptive system about them.
the design of an open learner model that can be used for explaining and justifying the inferences made by the system about the user.

we present an open learner model based on tree maps that shows evidence for a user’s knowledge, and that we evaluate the effectiveness of the model.

we have designed and implemented a tool that can be used to visualize the knowledge of users in adaptive learning systems in a transparent way, so that the users can see how their knowledge is being assessed and can use this knowledge to learn more effectively.
the system can help users to understand how the system is reasoning about them, and how they could change their behaviour to improve their learning.

visualizing evidence can make the inferences of a system more transparent to its users.
visualizing evidence can help users better understand the inferences about their knowledge, and can also be used to help them improve their knowledge.
